Name: Git for Windows
Description: The Inno Setup installer, wrapped and silenced, with a pointer at the inf file that is the only sane way to pin its options.
Awkwardness: Silencing Git is easy; deciding what it installs is not. The choices that matter later - which SSH client, which credential helper, which line-ending conversion, whether Git Bash is added to the terminal list - are not command-line switches at all. Left alone the installer takes its own defaults, and those defaults have changed between releases, so two machines imaged a year apart end up with different line-ending behaviour and nobody connects that to the packaging. The supported way to pin them is an answer file: run the installer once with /SAVEINF, then ship that file and pass /LOADINF. Git also upgrades itself in place from its own installer, so the version in Programs and Features can march ahead of the version the MSI wrapper believes it installed.
Notes: NOT tested in this repository. The switches are standard Inno Setup and transcribed from documentation, not verified here.
Run 'msimaker analyze <installer>' against your download; the Inno Setup fingerprint is unambiguous when it is there.

To pin the component and option choices: run the installer interactively once with /SAVEINF="C:\git.inf", add that inf to the payload as a second file, and append /LOADINF="[INSTALLFOLDER]git.inf" to the arguments. This has not been tested here, so try it on one device first.

No uninstall action is wired up. Inno Setup leaves unins000.exe in its install folder - usually C:\Program Files\Git - so once you have confirmed the path on a test device, add a Run action with Command and When: Uninstall of the form "C:\Program Files\Git\unins000.exe" /VERYSILENT /NORESTART.
/SP- suppresses the "this will install..." prompt and /SUPPRESSMSGBOXES answers the rest; without both, a silent install can still stop on a dialogue no one is there to see.
Set Version to the Git version you downloaded.

Arp.Comments: Git for Windows wrapped as an MSI. Silent switches from vendor documentation, untested.
